title: Require Domain Model Schema Owner Shape
forbids: domain model schema files outside their exact canonical schema-authoring dependency, re-export, and non-authority shape
why: Domain model schemas are reusable schema parts, not artifact validators, operation envelopes, or stage authoring surfaces. Exact acquisition selects only direct model/schemas members, and source-level import authority prevents aliases from smuggling artifact/runtime contracts or direct TypeBox validation into the kind.
remediate: Keep reusable schema primitives in model/schemas, import runtime schema authoring only from @swooper/mapgen-core/authoring/schema, keep relative dependencies inside sibling schemas, and move artifact setup or admission to the owning *.artifact.ts file, operation envelopes to contract.ts, and stage configuration to the owning stage.
message: Domain model schema files must remain plain composable schema parts without artifact, operation, recipe, or stage authority.
